game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 7 examination practice: Integer division: declare resource as int, apply resource / 3, and print each result with %d. Dataset 1 starts with [-3, 0, 13, 16]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

source_player_objective: Collect 390 points of water flasks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 390, or lives reach 0.
